description: This line plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-3. The x-axis represents the layer number, ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels appearing at regular intervals of 5. The y-axis represents the sparsity ratio, scaled linearly from 0.0 to 0.8. The plot contains three lines: a blue dashed line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio before the gate, averaging 0.003; an orange dotted line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio after the gate, averaging 0.126; and a green dashed line with circular markers representing the sparsity ratio after the average gate, averaging 0.080. The blue line remains near zero throughout, starting at approximately 0.01 and ending near 0.005. The orange line begins at approximately 0.8 and declines to about 0.04 near layer 10, then fluctuates slightly before settling near zero after layer 20. The green line starts at approximately 0.8 and declines more gradually to about 0.02 near layer 10, then also settles near zero after layer 20.
